summary: Plus trying to do things at scale with "blitzkrieg growth" is what got us in this mess... I would rather focus on a hyper local web rather than borrow metaphors from the Nazi war machine. The turtle does win the race after all.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Plus trying to do things at scale with "blitzkrieg growth" is what got us in this mess... I would rather focus on a hyper local web rather than borrow metaphors from the Nazi war machine.

The turtle does win the race after all.
